399ad7c96e62bc85.description: About the Role NASS Group & Corporation is seeking an HSE Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for implementing and monitoring Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) requirements across project sites, ensuring compliance with company policies, legislation, and British Standards. The HSE Officer will support the Safety Manager in maintaining a safe working environment and minimizing occupational risks. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with the Division's Health and Safety Policy, Management System, local procedures, method statements, and job instructions. Implement directives from the Regional Manager, General Manager, and Safety Manager, ensuring adherence by all personnel. Prepare and submit Monthly Accident and Training Reports and Company Accident Statistics. Collect completed Defect Report Forms and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Conduct random safety sampling and regular safety audits across project sites using specified checklists. Perform regular site inspections, identify hazards, assess risks, maintain inspection records, and ensure appropriate corrective actions. Inspect scaffolds before handover to Clients to ensure safe erection and compliance with applicable British Standards. Complete scaffold inspections using the Scaff-Tag Inspection Checklist, ensuring Scaff-Tags are displayed prominently. Maintain and update the Scaffold Inspection Record, including weekly inspections for scaffolds erected for seven days or longer, and additional inspections following modifications or adverse conditions. Ensure all employees receive appropriate safety induction training and are informed of Client safety requirements. Monitor hazardous materials and substances to which employees may be exposed. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with approved risk assessments, method statements, and safe working procedures. Report and assist in investigating accidents, incidents, near misses, and dangerous occurrences. Support the Safety Manager in implementing the Company's Health and Safety Policy and promoting a positive safety culture. Act as the site point of contact for Clients and contractors regarding Health, Safety, and Welfare matters. Report personnel failing to comply with their Health and Safety responsibilities. Ensure employees use equipment and PPE safely, report defects, and do not engage in unsafe practices. Cooperate in accident investigations and recommend corrective and preventive measures. Promote continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to eliminate hazards and enhance workplace safety. Set a positive personal example and perform additional duties as directed by management. Ensure relevant medical conditions affecting workplace safety are reported in accordance with company procedures. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. Demonstrated ability to implement and monitor HSE requirements on project sites. Proficiency in conducting safety inspections, audits, and accident investigations. Experience with scaffold inspections and compliance with British Standards. Strong understanding of health and safety policies, management systems, and local procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working across various project sites and collaborating with site teams, clients, and contractors to ensure a safe working environment. 39eaad7f84202415.job_title: Assistant Manager Cost Controller (F&B and Hospitality)
39eaad7f84202415.description: About Plaza Premium Group Plaza Premium Group, established in Hong Kong in 1998, is a leader in global airport hospitality, operating in over 200 locations across more than 60 international airports. The company focuses on "Making Travel Better" and spans four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and airport dining concepts. In addition to its own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates globally, and has developed Smart Traveler, a mobile-app rewards program. The Role: Assistant Manager Cost Controller (F&B and Hospitality) Plaza Premium Group is seeking an Assistant Manager Cost Controller specializing in F&B and Hospitality to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience to manage and analyze F&B costs, ensuring financial accuracy and operational efficiency within the hospitality sector. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze weekly and monthly F&B costs, including consumptions, purchase price variances, and other key cost indicators. Prepare F&B cost control and inventory reports, highlighting significant variances, trends, and areas requiring management attention. Monitor physical stock counts and reconcile inventory balances between physical stock and system records. Investigate inventory variances, abnormal stock movements, negative stock, wastage, breakages, transfers, and inventory adjustments. Monitor purchasing and receiving activities, including Purchase Orders, Delivery Notes, GRNs, invoice matching, and outstanding transactions. Review supplier pricing and quotation comparisons, highlighting significant price changes or purchasing discrepancies. Maintain and monitor recipe costing to ensure accurate reflection of products, UOMs, quantities, and costs. Support menu pricing and profitability reviews by verifying recipe accuracy, proposed selling prices, and profit margins. Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or incorrectly created products and coordinate with Procurement and Operations for corrective action. Monitor stock holding, stock turnover, slow-moving items, and potential obsolete inventory. Ensure compliance with Cost Control Operating Manuals, procedures, and internal control requirements. Conduct periodic process reviews and follow up with operational teams on identified control gaps and corrective actions. Provide practical cost control guidance to operational teams and support continuous improvement of F&B cost control processes. Assist with the implementation of new cost control processes, Operating Manuals, and training initiatives. Ensure all cost control activities, reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation are completed accurately and within required timelines. Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, strengthen internal controls, reduce unnecessary costs, and improve overall F&B profitability. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi nationality is preferred, subject to applicable Saudization requirements. Must hold a valid SOCPA membership or professional registration, where required by the applicable Saudi professional classification. Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of working experience in a similar position. Experience in receiving, store management, and hotel operations is an advantage. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Good knowledge and hands-on experience using Check SCM is mandatory, including F&B POS systems. High level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others to promote a strong teamwork environment. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic global organization focused on enhancing the travel experience.

39bc2eb5ba784a34.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية والإشراف على صيانتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع، المواد، والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية، التدفئة المركزية، وشبكات الغاز. متابعة الإشراف على تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. تشخيص الأعطال في المعدات الميكانيكية ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لضمان كفاءة المعدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تمديدات التدفئة الصحية والغاز أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لأسس تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات بدقة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل سيعمل الفني بدوام كامل ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالحديثة. تتطلب الوظيفة التواجد في المواقع المحددة في قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. طبيعة العمل تتضمن هذه الوظيفة مهام فنية وميدانية تتطلب الدقة في العمل والمتابعة المستمرة لضمان جودة التمديدات وصيانة المعدات الميكانيكية بكفاءة عالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة الوظيفية بدوام كامل.

39f98fce8d443dc0.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a Quality Manager - Construction Engineer to join our team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with a focus on projects in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves ensuring that all construction projects adhere to the highest quality standards, regulatory requirements, and client specifications. The successful candidate will oversee quality assurance processes, conduct inspections, and implement corrective actions to maintain excellence throughout project execution. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive quality management plans aligned with international standards and local Saudi construction codes. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to verify compliance with design specifications, building codes, and quality standards. Analyze construction materials, workmanship, and installation methods to identify defects and non-conformances. Document quality issues, prepare detailed inspection reports, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and subcontractors to resolve quality concerns and ensure timely remediation. Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality metrics and project compliance. Review technical drawings, specifications, and construction documents to ensure clarity and adherence to quality requirements. Maintain organized quality documentation, records, and databases for all projects and inspections. Provide technical guidance and training to site personnel on quality standards and best practices. Collaborate with project managers and engineers to develop solutions that balance quality, schedule, and cost objectives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant quality management or construction engineering role. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement quality management plans. Strong analytical skills for identifying defects and non-conformances in construction materials and methods. Proficiency in preparing detailed inspection reports and recommending corrective actions. Experience in coordinating with various project stakeholders to resolve quality concerns. The role requires a detail-oriented individual capable of working effectively within project teams and with external contractors.

394e83b4fc150fc9.description: About the Role Vanderlande is seeking a Site Electrical Supervisor Eng to oversee electrical equipment installations and controls commissioning activities for small project sites in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time role requires a strong on-site presence, focusing on safety and quality to ensure project success. The supervisor will lead a team, manage pre-commissioning, coordinate integration, and support testing activities, facilitating smooth site handovers. Key Responsibilities Organize and supervise on-site electrical activities, including installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical components such as power distribution, control panels, and wiring for material handling projects. Contribute to the creation of electrical installation schedules and review drawings, schematics, and equipment specifications for compliance with project requirements and electrical codes. Install PLC/HMIs, download OT software for controllers, and validate the correct function of safety and control cabinets. Execute and support pre-commissioning activities, including I/O checks, interface tests with SCADA, field wiring tests, and Mechanical Running Tests (MRT). Perform or support commissioning activities (functionality, capacity, requirements) and execute minor changes in OT programs while performing controls troubleshooting. Delegate responsibilities and provide clear instructions to the on-site installation team, ensuring adherence to quality standards and Vanderlande processes. Foster a culture of safety, organize all HSE-related activities on site, and conduct feasibility surveys for installation areas. Monitor team progress, report regularly to the site manager, and ensure effective coordination with subcontractors and stakeholders. Collaborate with the procurement team for timely delivery of electrical materials and equipment, and coordinate the installation and integration of third-party equipment. Document all installation activities, maintain accurate records, prepare progress reports, manage change orders and RFIs, and maintain red-line drawings for O&M. Identify opportunities for process improvement and support continuous enhancement efforts, including training new technicians. Organize and facilitate support activities for a smooth handover to commissioning and testing teams until customer handover, and support site logistics management. Key Deliverables As-Built Notes Defect List Electrical Static Test Report Field Wiring Test Report Before Power On Power-Up Protocol Test Report Cabinet Test Reports I/O Check Reports MRT Reports Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant electrical supervision or engineering role. Demonstrated ability to supervise electrical installations and controls commissioning activities. Proficiency in reviewing electrical drawings, schematics, and equipment specifications. Experience with PLC/HMI installation and OT software validation. Strong understanding of safety protocols and quality control standards in project execution. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires a strong on-site presence and involves regular site walks and quality checks. Travel to project sites will be necessary for project execution and support, with requirements varying based on project needs and locations.

397f4d3e1d4bc0a2.description: About the Role flyadeal is seeking a Cabin Crew member to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 390737b5c96bdbfa.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Guest Service Associate to provide professional guest services in airport lounges across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. 398945fe9cd4aa42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية من المريض وذويه، ودراسة الحالة المرضية، وإجراء الفحص السريري اللازم. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية، والصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية، وقراءة النتائج والتقارير المتعلقة بها. تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص. وضع الخطط العلاجية المناسبة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي ذي الصلة. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية ووضع الخطط العلاجية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. مكان العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الباحة، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان لتقديم رعاية صحية متكاملة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

399f4a2312e67458.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Mechanical Engineer / Senior Mechanical Engineer with specialized experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. Manage and oversee mechanical maintenance activities during SD/TA operations. Work with various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Ensure adherence to project schedules and operational requirements. 399a7f5123a58326.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة خالد سليم الأحمدي للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تطبيق قوانين ولوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية، وإجراء عمليات التفتيش، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تطبيق اللوائح والتعليمات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في نجران. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق الشركة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم.

39a380f8e0cc7fa3.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, operating in over 150 countries with a mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. The company's 95,000 employees are dedicated to developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of over 72 million patients annually. Joining Medtronic offers a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact, contributing to the future of healthcare and championing healthcare access and equity. The Role of Associate Customer Service Specialist Medtronic is seeking an Associate Customer Service Specialist for a full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role serves as the direct contact for all customer order management within the region for Medtronic Saudi Arabia’s Business Units and for the Medtronic International Customer Care & Supply Chain group. The specialist will manage sales/purchase order processing and related documentation, working closely with the Customer Care & Supply Chain Manager, Business Unit Managers, and Finance Manager. This position supports sales activities and contributes to structural improvement projects, requiring knowledge of Incoterms, customs clearance, certification procedures, and product flow through third-party logistics to transit warehouses and final customers. The core challenge involves understanding customer-specific requirements and addressing their needs effectively. Key Responsibilities Represent the company to both external and internal customers. Process and follow up on customer orders in compliance with current policies, procedures, and work instructions. Monitor and follow up on financial (payment) situations, ensuring fulfillment of contractual terms by customers in close collaboration with the Finance department and Business Unit Managers. Support sales contracts and related documentation. Develop and maintain close day-to-day relationships with distributors and service providers. Maintain accurate Customer and Material Master Files. Collaborate with Customers and Business Unit Managers to identify and implement structural process improvements. Manage web-based ordering or registrations. Confer with management regarding customer credits and returns goods for credit. Identify quality assurance complaints and write price differentials on mail orders. Manage inventories at customer facilities using EDI (electronic data interchange), forecasting, replenishment, and inventory systems, focusing on stock and allocation issues to maximize service levels. Manage customer complaints and the return process. Coordinate on warranty issues. Maintain return acceptance criteria. Follow up on Distribution Hold Notifications and the return of hold products to Medtronic suppliers. Support the organization of excellent, efficient third-party warehousing & distribution operations. Support the establishment of an effective quality management system. Required Experience Candidates for this position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. Work Location This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

39d14bf3de4d7713.description: About Honeywell Technologies Honeywell Technologies is a global company focused on innovation across various sectors, including aerospace, building technologies, and performance materials. Complete assigned training sessions to become familiar with Honeywell products and solutions. Participate in various activities within the project lifecycle, including hardware visual inspection and loop checks. Proactively seek to build cross-discipline experience and increase knowledge through collaboration with other engineers. Report progress and technical problems or changes to the supervising engineer. Qualifications and Requirements Applicants must be Saudi Nationals. Applicants must be in the final stages of their graduation requirements. The duration of the internship will be as specified in the training letter from the university. Majors should be in one of the following engineering disciplines: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or Process Instrumentation & Control. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this internship opportunity with Honeywell Technologies.

39cc9993dab674e0.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco | أرامكو السعودية is seeking an Upstream & LNG Strategist to join the Corporate Strategy Department. This full-time role involves contributing to the company's strategy development and update process. The primary focus will be advising on upstream strategic direction, shaping the LNG portfolio, and evaluating investment opportunities to support long-term value creation. Key Responsibilities Advise Corporate and Executive Management on strategic goals and long-term plans for Upstream and LNG businesses, operating at the center of strategic decision-making and portfolio development. Guide the development of upstream and LNG sections within the Company’s corporate strategy, short-term business plan, and long-term investment plans, ensuring consistency with corporate objectives and capital discipline frameworks. Collaborate with Business Lines and other corporate functions to integrate technical, commercial, and financial perspectives into strategic recommendations for the upstream and LNG businesses. Initiate and provide in-depth analysis of global upstream and LNG market dynamics, including supply-demand balances, pricing benchmarks, contract structures, regulatory developments, and competitive positioning. Lead the strategic assessment of upstream and LNG investment opportunities, including greenfield and brownfield developments, commercialization models, market entry strategies, and partnership structures. Provide strategic input into M&A screenings and growth initiatives within the LNG portfolio. Evaluate capital allocation trade-offs and support investment decision processes with robust financial and strategic analysis. Prepare and present high-quality materials to executive leadership forums and senior decision-making committees on Upstream and LNG strategies. Build and maintain a network of LNG subject matter experts, specialist consultants, and industrial organizations to advise corporate management on market shifts and developments impacting the sector. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in Upstream & LNG within an international oil and gas company, global energy consulting firm, think tank, or financial institution. At least 5 years of this experience must be in strategy, corporate planning, or consulting roles with demonstrated executive-level exposure. Extensive LNG sector experience is essential, including deep knowledge of LNG value chain economics, commercialization structures, global trade flows, and investment trends. Business development or project management experience within the LNG sector is highly desirable. Proven ability to develop, articulate, and present corporate-level strategy to executive teams. 394ac8d3d97780f3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل وتوزيع المهام وتقييم الأداء، بهدف ضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لعمليات الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تصميم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل فعالة. مهارات جيدة في تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير فرق العمل. القدرة على متابعة وتقييم الأداء وتوزيع المهام بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

39ea6d8f8f902ea5.description: About the Role GRG is seeking a Construction Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 39a79629b1e82548.description: About Khazna Khazna is a fintech platform dedicated to enhancing financial inclusion through accessible financial services. As the company expands its consumer business across Saudi Arabia and Egypt, it seeks a Senior Director of Growth to establish and scale a data-driven growth function. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports directly to the Group CEO, serving as a key member of the senior leadership team. Role Overview The Senior Director of Growth will be responsible for driving sustainable growth across the entire customer journey for Khazna's B2B2C and Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) businesses. This includes overseeing acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and customer lifetime value. The role requires a leader who can move between strategic planning and execution, challenge assumptions with data, and build capabilities for sustainable growth in an evolving, regulated financial services environment. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute growth strategies across Saudi Arabia and Egypt, identifying priority customer segments, products, channels, and market opportunities. Build scalable acquisition and distribution models across digital, organic, referral, and strategic partnership channels. Manage growth performance across the customer funnel, balancing acquisition, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value with commercial profitability. Lead the growth and expansion of Khazna's D2C business in Saudi Arabia and identify opportunities to deepen customer engagement and product adoption in Egypt. Partner with Product and Technology teams to optimize customer journeys, including onboarding, KYC, activation, product adoption, and repeat usage. Utilize customer behavior, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, improve conversion, and influence product priorities. Develop lifecycle and CRM strategies to enhance engagement, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value. Establish measurement, analytics, and experimentation capabilities to support data-driven growth decisions. Lead structured experimentation across acquisition, product journeys, and customer engagement, scaling initiatives with measurable results. Build and lead a high-performing growth function across Saudi Arabia and Egypt, developing necessary capabilities, teams, and operating mechanisms. Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Technology, Data, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, and Risk teams. Candidate Profile and Qualifications Over 10 years of significant senior leadership experience in growth within consumer fintech, digital financial services, e-commerce, marketplaces, or high-growth consumer technology. Proven experience in building and/or scaling a substantial D2C business with measurable commercial results. Strong expertise in product-led growth, growth analytics, experimentation, and customer lifecycle management. Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams on the technical foundations of growth, including tracking, analytics, attribution, and experimentation. Strong commercial understanding of unit economics, customer acquisition costs, retention, and lifetime value. Experience in building and leading high-performing teams and delivering results through cross-functional collaboration. Understanding of consumer lending, payments, BNPL, digital banking, or related financial services models. Experience in Saudi Arabia, Egypt, or the broader GCC/MENA region is strongly preferred. Familiarity with platforms such as GA4, AppsFlyer, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Braze, CleverTap, or equivalent tools. Leadership Approach The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, analytical, and hands-on leader capable of navigating between strategy and execution. This role requires an individual comfortable operating in an evolving environment, developing strong teams, and influencing cross-functional priorities while maintaining discipline within a regulated financial services business.

39dec8a0d16cc47d.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer for a full-time position. This role involves planning and supervising all maintenance activities for plant electrical equipment, including preventive and corrective maintenance, monthly/annual outages, and overhauling work. The Electrical Engineer will work under the direction of the Section Head, ensuring operational efficiency and adherence to maintenance schedules. Key Responsibilities Assign preventive and corrective maintenance jobs as directed by the Section Head, supervising and coordinating the activities of maintenance staff. Maintain records, prepare reports, and compose correspondence related to work activities. Execute work orders through the CMMS (SAP) and coordinate with the planning engineer for job completion and technical matters. Ensure necessary communications and relations are maintained to report on the status of matters requiring action and to facilitate corrective measures. Assist the Maintenance Manager in executing corrective and planned maintenance in line with the annual scheduled maintenance plan. Perform technical evaluations of quotations received from the purchase department and recommend appropriate choices. Prepare purchase requisitions for spare parts and consumables, ensuring budgetary compliance and strategic spares availability to meet maintenance requirements. Review and recommend new maintenance procedures and work instructions. Supervise, direct, and coordinate the activities of all personnel assigned to the area. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report on IMS objectives, targets, and programs, providing necessary resources for effective implementation and sustenance. Ensure legal, contractual, and organizational compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions, including annual performance evaluations and on-the-job training for new employees. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area, ensuring identified aspects are monitored and operational controls are followed. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within a plant maintenance environment. Proficiency in executing work orders through CMMS (SAP) is required. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance principles. Ability to perform technical evaluations and manage spare parts procurement. Experience with Integrated Management Systems (IMS) and environmental/safety compliance. Work Environment The role involves working near moving mechanical parts and in various outdoor weather conditions. Occasional exposure to high precarious places, fumes, airborne particles, toxic or chemical risks, and electrical shock may occur. The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate but can be very loud at times. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Electrical Engineer position at Acwa.

39d875dc5a989894.description: Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region, enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and serve their customers across digital channels at scale. This role is ideal for an engineer with 0–2 years of professional experience who has a solid foundation in frontend development and wants to grow in an environment where ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement matter. Use AI to automate repetitive work and spend more time solving meaningful engineering problems. Continuously explore better AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity and engineering velocity. Ask questions when necessary while developing the ability to investigate and unblock yourself. Give and receive constructive feedback during code reviews and technical discussions. Help teammates when needed and actively share what you learn. Take responsibility for the quality of what you ship. Treat the product as something you own — not simply a collection of assigned tickets. Stack Our frontend ecosystem includes: React JavaScript (ES6+) TypeScript React Query / TanStack Query Redux / Redux Toolkit Jest Playwright WebSockets / Socket.IO RabbitMQ REST APIs Git Modern AI-assisted development tools Experience with every technology is not required, but you should have strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field. 0–2 years of professional frontend development experience. Strong understanding of JavaScript fundamentals . Hands-on experience building applications with React . Good understanding of TypeScript and type-safe development. Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle. Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data. Familiarity with React Query / TanStack Query and Redux / Redux Toolkit . Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as Jest and Playwright . Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets / Socket.IO . Basic understanding of message queues and event-driven systems , especially RabbitMQ . Understanding of common real-time challenges such as reconnection, duplicate events, stale data, race conditions, and keeping UI state synchronized. Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals . Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows. Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code. Practical experience using AI tools to improve software engineering productivity . Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve. Good communication and teamwork skills. This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works." Care about both speed and quality — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other. Use AI to multiply your productivity while still understanding and owning every solution you ship. Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it. Try to understand why something works, not only how to make it work. Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability. Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve. Communicate early when you are blocked. Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers. Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you. Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes. Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done. Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years. What Success Looks Like Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to: Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow. Deliver production features with increasing independence. Write clean and maintainable code that requires fewer review iterations over time. Build appropriate automated tests for the features you develop. Work confidently with REST APIs and increasingly understand our real-time architecture. Debug frontend and integration issues effectively. Use AI tools to noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality . Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews. Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering
